definitions.gloss: to hum; to croon; to sing softly to oneself
definitions.explanation: To sing or hum a melody quietly, often unconsciously or absent-mindedly. Implies a casual, relaxed mood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鼻歌|はなうた}→鼻歌：18017_hanauta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{口|くち}ずさんで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{口|くち}ずさむ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧だ。
examples.english: Humming my favorite songs while taking a walk is part of my daily routine.

notes:
To sing or hum softly to oneself, often absent-mindedly or in a relaxed mood. Conveys a warm, gentle image.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the song or melody being hummed

ALTERNATIVE WRITING:
Can also be written {口遊|くちずさ}む.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{口|くち}ずさむ: to hum a song
- ⟦メロディー→メロディー：05877_merodii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{口|くち}ずさむ: to hum a melody
- {口|くち}ずさんで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be humming (ongoing)
- ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{口|くち}ずさむ: to hum without thinking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鼻歌|はなうた}を{歌|うた}う→鼻歌を歌う：24200_hanautawoutau⟧: to hum (through the nose)
- ⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧: to sing (louder, more deliberate)

REGISTER:
Slightly literary. Common in written descriptions and narratives.
